description: Stop an apply that is running in the background: no further step is started and the Shopify bulk operations it started are cancelled. What was already written stays written (nothing is rolled back or deleted). Also stops bulk operations left running by an apply whose server was restarted. If the apply has already ended, nothing is cancelled and its final state is returned. Returns { plan_id, state (cancelling, or interrupted for an apply from before a restart), note }. Follow with apply_status, then plan_sync to see what is left.

plan_id.description: The plan being applied. Default: the most recent apply.

name: cancel_apply
title: Cancel an apply
